answer: Gate emission behind witnessed novelty: every answer is hashed into a quartz-hard dedup index, and payout weight accrues only when non-kin jurors seal work as original. Cloning accounts then buys an attacker nothing but multiplied inference bills: each seat needs its own independent seals, rented from peers whose stake burns on a false verdict.
